svg.title: AFTERLIGHT benchmarks
svg.desc: Two exploratory recording pairs: Cross-city ordinary 601 seconds versus priority 473 seconds, 21.3 percent shorter with civilian mean excess increasing 2.19 seconds; Westhaven 426.5 versus 322.5 seconds, 24.4 percent shorter with civilian mean excess increasing 1.14 seconds. One desktop, two foreground 30-second windows: overview 152.5 FPS, close follow 129.7 FPS; p95 frame intervals 12.1 and 12.2 milliseconds. Warm offline Python five-candidate selection, 2400 calls per method across 12 validation snapshots: learned median 0.2241 ms and p95 0.2512 ms; analytical median 0.0429 ms and p95 0.0549 ms. Recorded fixed/analytical priority examples and the offline AI study are separate.
svg.title: AFTERLIGHT recorded journeys and measured performance
